violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: ice scoop stored with handle in contact with consumable ice in ice machine.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. Person in charge removed ice scoop and discarded contaminated ice.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The handwashing sink at cook line and prep line are operating between 50F and 63F.
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet. PIC repaired hand sinks to operate at 123F.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: @EQUIPMENT@. HIGH-TEMPERATURE DISHWASHER IS NOT SANITIZING. SURFACE TEMPERATURE OF DISHWASHER TESTER WAS 157F.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. 3-COMPARTMENT SINK WILL BE USED TO SANITIZE ALL FOOD CONTACT SURFACES.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: 2 CONTINENTAL 1-DOOR COOLERS IN THE DINNING AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. CFM WILL PROVIDED THERMOMETERS FOR THEM.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Controlling Pests, Pest Control Methods
violations.observation: Methods are not being used to control pests. OBSERVED LIVE FLIES IN KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Insects and other pests are capable of transmitting disease to people by contaminating food and food-contact surfaces. If pests are found on the premises methods shall be used to control their presence. PLEASE OBTAIN URGENT PEST CONTROL SERVICE WITHIN 10 CALENDAR DAYS.
